title: Input reorientation equivalence
statement: For a point $\sigma$ of the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, reorient the cube by sending each point $x$ to the point whose $i$th coordinate is $\sigma_i x_i$. This map is a bijection, and applying it twice returns the original point.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a point of the Boolean cube
